$comment: skill-split-screen-edit geometry and pacing (1080x1920). Measured from the reference Video-94146 (720x1280, scaled; about +-1-2% of height) and the planning rules in docs/plans/skill-split-screen-edit.md. Tools: tools/recipes/split-screen.mjs (planner), tools/blocks/split.mjs (layout writer), tools/jobs/split-check.mjs. Change numbers here, not in the tools.

seam.$note: B panel y 0..bBottom with a fade to black from fadeFrom; presenter panel aTop..H with a shade from aTop (dark) to shadeTo (clear); the caption sits on the dark band at captionY.

presenter.$note: Static face-safe crop per split window. Hard: the face box (sides of face width each side, chin extended by chinDown) stays in x margin..W-margin, y shadeTo..H-margin. Soft: the hair top (hairUp of face height above the forehead) stays below aTop+margin. On at least (1 - maxOut) of a window's frames; else a smaller scale (down to fitMin of a cover fit) with a blurred side fill; else the window becomes a-full (<= 4 s) or b-full.

matte.$note: rcg matte settings for the darken cut-out: a wider choke and feather hide the light hair fringe the selfie segmenter leaves (R12).

bfull.$note: Treatments: cover (portrait footage), fit (landscape footage and UI: contained at full width over a blurred, darkened cover copy), band (cards: a white band over dark grey).

afull.$note: Full-frame presenter: the marketing-pro face camera; a two-tier title (small sans lead + italic serif key words) at chest height, in front of the subject.

pacing.$note: Seconds. Layout windows break 'lead' before the motivating word. Shares are soft targets (reported, the planner demotes extra a-full windows).
